entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the mountain bike cycling shoes I bought. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for these... but they're just not working out. I feel awful about it.
I understand. And is it a technical fault with the shoes, or more of a fit and preference issue?

It's the fit. I've tried adjusting the cleats every which way, but no matter what I do, I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for ten minutes. I really needed this money, and now I have shoes I can't even use.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. That sounds very painful, and I can see why you'd be disappointed. Let me pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay, I have your order right here. I see the shoes were delivered 13 days ago. The good news is that you are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
Oh, really? A full refund? Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. All you need to do is package the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's... such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried. I really appreciate your help.
You are very welcome. We want you to be happy with your gear. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
